pages.title: Cracked Golden Core
pages.text: Death during Golden Core tribulation leaves a cracked core and Half-step Golden Core. Open cultivation stats to inspect the realm and core state.$(br2)This is a recovery route after failure; no deliberate death is needed to learn it. Ordinary breakthrough failure and death during Golden Core lightning have different consequences.

pages.title: Attempt Golden Core Again
pages.text: A renewed attempt from Half-step Golden Core needs twice the Late Foundation cultivation progress requirement. Recover Qi and satisfy the displayed method and other breakthrough conditions.$(br2)Complete the renewed challenge and tribulation to become Golden Core; the earlier failure does not count as success.
